snippet.title: Gospel Drift - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
In Hell, there are no stop signs! Hunt demons for souls and compete with other cars that want to take them from you! 

Let grandma take the wheel! Kick Satans whiny little ass and collect the souls of the damned to buy upgrades and slam the hordes that stand in your way...literally. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4418100/Gospel_Drift/

Developer: Retromagine
X: https://x.com/RETROMAGINE
